en.name: Build and test your first agent
en.teaches: Creating an agent, writing instructions that hold, and using the test pane to see why it answered the way it did.
en.build: A working agent that answers from its instructions alone, and a habit of reading the test pane rather than guessing.
en.objective: Create an agent, shape its behaviour with instructions, and diagnose any answer from the test pane.

skills: None — this is the starting point
tools: An environment you may build in
materials: Nothing. This one starts empty on purpose

steps: Create an agent and name it for the task, not the technology.
Write the instructions as rules: what it must do, and what it must refuse.
Ask three questions in the test pane — one it should answer, one it should refuse, one genuinely ambiguous.
Change a single line of the instructions and watch the same three answers move.
Publish to the test channel and open it the way a user would.
en.summary: You have an agent whose behaviour you can predict, and a way to find out why when you cannot.

zh.name: 建出并测试你的第一个 agent
zh.teaches: 创建 agent、把说明写得站得住、以及用测试面板看清楚它为什么这么答。
zh.build: 一个只靠说明就能作答的 agent，以及「看测试面板而不是靠猜」的习惯。
zh.objective: 会建 agent、会用说明控制它的行为、并能从测试面板看出任一回答是怎么来的。

tools: 一个允许你建东西的环境
materials: 不需要。这一课故意从空白开始

steps: 建一个 agent，名字按它要干的活起，不按技术起。
把说明写成规则：它必须做什么、必须拒绝什么。
在测试面板问三个问题——一个它该答、一个它该拒、一个真的模棱两可。
改说明里的一行，看同样这三个回答怎么变。
发布到测试渠道，用真实用户的方式打开它。
zh.summary: 你有了一个行为可预测的 agent，以及在它不可预测时查出原因的办法。

en.do: You land straight on the Build canvas. There is no wizard to sit through — name, instructions and configuration are all one screen.
en.see: Build / Preview / Evaluate / Monitor across the top. A model is already chosen, and Knowledge already holds one entry: Search all websites.
en.note: Point at that default web knowledge now, before anyone asks why the agent is quoting the internet in ten minutes' time.

zh.do: 直接落在 Build 画布上。没有向导要走——名字、说明、配置都在同一屏。
zh.see: 顶部是 Build / Preview / Evaluate / Monitor。模型已经选好，Knowledge 里也已经有一条：Search all websites。
zh.note: 现在就把那个默认的联网知识指出来——十分钟后会有人问「它怎么引的是网上的东西」。

en.act: Name it, then write the instructions as rules
en.where: Build → the name field, then Instructions
en.do: Name it for the job it does. Replace the placeholder instructions: what it must do, then what it must refuse. Save.
en.type:
You answer employee questions about the company expense policy.

Answer only about expenses. If asked about anything else — payroll, HR, IT — say you only handle expenses and stop.

If you are not certain, say you are not certain. Never guess a monetary limit.
en.see: Saving creates the agent and unlocks the Evaluate tab. The Save button then greys out — that is how you know it took.
en.note: The refusal clause and the 'never guess' clause are the load-bearing ones. You will watch both fire in a moment.

zh.act: 先命名，再把说明写成规则
zh.where: Build → 名称输入框，然后 Instructions
zh.do: 名字按它要干的活起。把占位说明整段替掉：先写必须做什么，再写必须拒绝什么。保存。
zh.type:
You answer employee questions about the company expense policy.

Answer only about expenses. If asked about anything else — payroll, HR, IT — say you only handle expenses and stop.

If you are not certain, say you are not certain. Never guess a monetary limit.
zh.see: 保存会真正创建 agent，并解锁 Evaluate 页签。Save 按钮随后变灰——这就是存上了的信号。
zh.note: 起作用的是那句「拒绝」和那句「不准猜」。马上你会亲眼看到它俩生效。

en.act: Ask the one it should answer
en.do: Ask a question squarely inside its job. Then read the reasoning trace above the answer, not just the answer.
en.type: Can I expense a taxi to the airport?
en.see: It loads a search-before-answer skill, calls tools, and reports it could not find a company policy. It then states outright that it will not guess a dollar cap — and cites the public web instead.
en.note: Two lessons on one screen. The instruction held. And with no company knowledge attached, that default web source is what it fell back on — which is precisely what Lab 02 fixes.

zh.do: 问一个正好在它职责范围内的问题。然后读回答上方的推理过程，而不只是读回答。
zh.type: Can I expense a taxi to the airport?
zh.see: 它加载了 search-before-answer 技能、调用了工具，并说明没找到公司政策。接着它直说不会猜金额上限——然后引了公开网页。
zh.note: 一屏两个教训。说明生效了。而在没有公司知识的情况下，它只能回退到默认的联网源——而这正是 Lab 02 要解决的。

en.act: Ask the one it should refuse
en.do: Ask something plainly outside its remit.
en.type: How much holiday do I have left?
en.see: Two sentences, no hedging, and a redirect to HR. No web search and no citations — it did not even try.
en.note: Compare the length against the previous answer. A good refusal is short. If yours runs three paragraphs, the instruction is too soft.

zh.do: 问一个明显不归它管的事。
zh.type: How much holiday do I have left?
zh.see: 两句话，不拖泥带水，直接指向 HR。没搜网、没引用——它根本没去试。
zh.note: 把它和上一个回答的长度比一下。好的拒绝是短的。如果你的拒绝有三段，说明说明写得太软了。

en.do: Ask the question that has no clean answer without your own policy.
en.type: Is a client dinner an expense or entertainment?
en.see: A confident, well-sourced, detailed answer on tax treatment — closing with an explicit caveat that it cannot find your policy and will not guess your cap.
en.note: This is the slide for the business people. Everything above the caveat is correct and useless; the caveat is the honest part. That gap is the entire argument for Lab 02.

zh.do: 问一个没有你们自己的政策就答不干净的问题。
zh.type: Is a client dinner an expense or entertainment?
zh.see: 一个笃定、有出处、很详细的税务口径回答——结尾明确声明：找不到你们的政策，不会猜你们的上限。
zh.note: 这一张是给业务方看的。声明以上的内容都对，但都没用；那句声明才是诚实的部分。这个落差就是 Lab 02 存在的理由。

en.act: Publish, then look at it as a user
en.where: Publish, then Preview → End user preview
en.do: Publish and wait for it to finish. Then turn on End user preview and start a new chat with the same first question.
en.see: The same answer, but the reasoning trace, the skill loading and the tool calls are all gone. The user gets the conclusion and the citations, nothing else.
en.note: Do this at the end of every lab. What the maker sees and what the user sees diverge immediately, and only one of them ships.

zh.act: 发布，然后用用户的眼睛看一遍
zh.where: Publish，然后 Preview → End user preview
zh.do: 发布并等它完成。然后打开 End user preview，新开一段对话，问同样的第一个问题。
zh.see: 回答一样，但推理过程、技能加载、工具调用全没了。用户只拿到结论和引用。
zh.note: 每一课结束都做一次。作者看到的和用户看到的立刻就分岔了，而上线的只有其中一个。

en.name: Ground it in your own documents
en.teaches: Adding knowledge sources, checking what was actually retrieved, and making the agent cite rather than assert.
en.build: An agent that answers only from documents you chose, shows its source, and says so when it does not know.
en.objective: Point an agent at your own documents and make it answer from them — with the source shown, and a refusal when the answer is not there.

tools: A SharePoint site or Teams channel you can read
materials: A SharePoint site holding the documents — including two editions of one of them

steps: Add a knowledge source, and wait for indexing to finish before judging anything.
Ask a question whose answer is definitely in there, then check which document it cited.
Ask one whose answer is definitely not, and make it say so rather than invent.
Turn on citations and confirm a reader could verify the answer without you.
Ask something the documents answer inconsistently — that is the case your users will hit.
en.summary: Answers are now traceable to a source, which is the difference between a demo and something a business will accept.

zh.name: 让它依据你自己的文档作答
zh.teaches: 添加知识来源、检查它实际检索到了什么、以及让它给出处而不是张口就来。
zh.build: 一个只依据你选定的文档作答、并给出出处、不知道就说不知道的 agent。
zh.objective: 能把 agent 接到你自己的文档上，让它依据文档作答、给出出处，没有依据时直接拒答。

tools: 一个你读得了的 SharePoint 站点或 Teams 频道
materials: 一个放着这些文档的 SharePoint 站点——其中至少有一份文档存两个版本

steps: 添加知识来源，等索引建完再下任何结论。
问一个答案肯定在里面的问题，然后看它引了哪份文档。
再问一个答案肯定不在里面的，逼它说「没有」而不是编。
打开引用，确认读者不需要你帮忙就能核对。
问一个文档里自相矛盾的问题——那才是你用户会碰上的情况。
zh.summary: 回答现在能追溯到出处——这就是「演示」和「业务愿意接受的东西」之间的差别。

en.do: Look at what the options actually are before choosing one. Public websites, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure SQL — and a plain file upload.
en.see: Uploading a file is the fastest path and the worst habit. A file uploaded here is a copy that will drift from the original the moment somebody edits it.
en.note: Take the SharePoint route even though it is slower to set up. Grounding on the live library is the difference between a demo and something the business can keep.

zh.do: 先看清楚有哪些选项，再决定用哪个。公开网站、SharePoint、OneDrive、Azure SQL——以及直接传文件。
zh.see: 直接传文件最快，也最坐不住。传上去的是一份副本，原件一被人改，它就对不上了。
zh.note: 宁可麻烦一点也走 SharePoint。接在活的文档库上，才是「演示」和「业务能长期用」的分界线。

en.act: Point it at the SharePoint site
en.do: Paste the site URL rather than browsing. Then give the source a name a human would recognise — that name appears in citations.
en.see: The site resolves to a row with an editable name and description. The dialog warns that SharePoint knowledge is only available to authenticated end users.
en.note: That warning is the security model, not a caveat. The agent sees exactly what the person asking is allowed to see — which is why grounding on SharePoint is defensible where a copied file is not.

zh.act: 把它指向 SharePoint 站点
zh.do: 直接粘站点 URL，别用浏览。然后给这个源起一个人看得懂的名字——这个名字会出现在引用里。
zh.see: 站点解析成一行，名称和描述都可改。对话框会提醒：SharePoint 知识只对已认证的终端用户可用。
zh.note: 那句提醒不是免责声明，而是安全模型。agent 能看到的，就是提问的人有权看到的——这就是为什么接 SharePoint 站得住，而拷一份文件站不住。

en.where: Build → Knowledge → remove Search all websites, then Save
en.do: Delete the web knowledge entry that Lab 01 caught quoting the internet. Save, and wait for indexing before judging anything.
en.see: Knowledge now lists one source. This is the moment the agent stops being able to answer from the open web.
en.note: Leave the web source in and every test below is contaminated — you will never know whether an answer came from the policy or from a tax blog.

zh.where: Build → Knowledge → 删除 Search all websites，然后 Save
zh.do: 把 Lab 01 里那个“引网上内容”的联网知识条目删掉。保存，并等索引建完再下结论。
zh.see: Knowledge 里现在只剩一个源。从这一刻起，agent 再也不能从公开网络作答。
zh.note: 不删它，下面每一项测试都是脏的——你永远不知道答案是来自政策还是来自某个税务博客。

en.do: Ask the question Lab 01 could not answer, and this time look at the citation before the answer.
en.type: What is the daily limit for meals when travelling?
en.see: It loads an analysing-docx skill, returns the figures, and cites the document by filename. It picks the current edition over the superseded one without being asked.
en.note: Same question as Lab 01. Then it refused to guess a cap; now it states one and shows you where it came from. That is the whole value of this lab in one screen.

zh.do: 问 Lab 01 答不了的那个问题，这次先看引用，再看回答。
zh.type: What is the daily limit for meals when travelling?
zh.see: 它加载了 analyzing-docx 技能，给出具体金额，并按文件名引用。没人告诉它，它自己选了现行版而不是废止版。
zh.note: 和 Lab 01 同一个问题。当时它拒绝猜上限；现在它给出了一个，并且告诉你出处。这一屏就是这节课的全部价值。

en.act: Ask what they do not cover
en.do: Ask something adjacent to the policy but not in it, and read the whole answer including the reasoning.
en.type: What is the limit for a meal in Oslo on a public holiday?
en.see: It states plainly that no city or public-holiday rate exists, applies the nearest rule that does, flags that the superseded edition says something different, and routes you to the exception process. Two citations.
en.note: Nobody asked it to compare editions. Put two versions of a document in a library and the agent will find the disagreement — which is a content problem for whoever owns those documents, and they should be in the room.

zh.do: 问一个贴着政策、但政策里没写的问题，连推理过程一起读完。
zh.type: What is the limit for a meal in Oslo on a public holiday?
zh.see: 它直说没有城市或节假日的专项标准，改用最接近的那条规则，指出废止版的数字不一样，并把你引到例外审批流程。两条引用。
zh.note: 没人让它去对比版本。只要库里有两个版本，agent 就会把矛盾翻出来——而这是内容的问题，管文档的人得在场。

en.name: Pin the paths that must be deterministic
en.teaches: Topics and trigger phrases, and where a scripted path beats letting the model decide.
en.build: One conversation that always goes the same way — the one your compliance people would ask about.
en.objective: Pin the parts of a conversation that must never vary, and tell the difference between what the model may decide and what it must not.

materials: One exchange where a wrong answer has consequences

steps: Pick the exchange your compliance people would ask about first.
Build it as a topic with explicit trigger phrases.
Force it down the scripted path and confirm it cannot be talked out of it.
Add a fallback for when the trigger is missed entirely.
Re-test the generative path to confirm the topic did not swallow unrelated questions.
en.summary: One conversation now behaves identically every time, and you have a rule for deciding which others need the same.

zh.name: 把必须确定的路径钉死
zh.teaches: Topics 与触发短语，以及什么地方「写死的流程」优于「让模型自己决定」。
zh.build: 一段永远走同一条路的对话——就是合规同事一定会问的那一段。
zh.objective: 能把对话中绝不允许变的部分钉死，并分清哪些能交给模型判断、哪些绝对不能。

materials: 一段答错了会有后果的对话

steps: 挑出合规同事最先会追问的那一段。
把它做成一个 Topic，写明确的触发短语。
逼它走写死的流程，确认它不会被话术带偷。
为「触发词没命中」加一条兵底路径。
重测生成式那条路，确认这个 Topic 没把无关问题也吞了。
zh.summary: 你有了一段每次表现一致的对话，以及一条判断「还有哪些也该这么处理」的标准。

en.act: Choose the exchange that must not vary
en.where: On the whiteboard, before you touch the product
en.do: Ask the room which single exchange their compliance people would ask about first. Write it down before building anything.
en.see: Usually a disagreement. That disagreement is the useful output of this step.
en.note: Skipping this and building a topic you invented is how labs produce something nobody needed.

zh.act: 选出那段不允许变的对话
zh.where: 先在白板上，先别碰产品
zh.do: 问全场：合规的人最先会追问哪一段对话？先把它写下来，再开始建。
zh.see: 通常会吵起来。这个分歧就是这一步真正的产出。
zh.note: 跳过这一步、直接建一个自己想的 topic，就是 Lab 做出一堆没人需要的东西的原因。

en.where: Your agent → Topics → Add a topic → From blank
en.do: Add trigger phrases in the words your users actually use, not the words the policy uses.
en.type:
how do I claim mileage
mileage claim
claim for driving
petrol money
en.see: The topic saves with its trigger phrases listed, and an empty conversation canvas below.
en.note: Users do not say 'mileage reimbursement request'. Trigger phrases written in policy language never fire.

zh.where: 你的 agent → Topics → Add a topic → From blank
zh.do: 触发词用用户真会说的话写，不是用制度文件里的话写。
zh.type:
how do I claim mileage
mileage claim
claim for driving
petrol money
zh.see: topic 保存后列出触发词，下面是一块空的对话画布。
zh.note: 用户不会说「里程费报销申请」。用制度语言写的触发词永远触发不了。

en.act: Force it down the scripted path
en.do: Trigger the topic, then try to talk it out of the script mid-way.
en.type: actually never mind, just tell me the limit
en.see: It should hold the path. If it wanders back to generative answering, the topic is not doing its job.
en.note: This is the whole point of a topic: the parts a regulator asks about must not be improvised.

zh.do: 触发这个 topic，然后在中途试图把它从脚本里带出去。
zh.type: actually never mind, just tell me the limit
zh.see: 它应该守住路径。如果又滑回生成式回答，说明这个 topic 没起到作用。
zh.note: 这就是 topic 存在的意义：监管会追问的部分，不允许即兴发挥。

en.where: Topics → your topic → add a fallback branch
en.do: Phrase the same request in a way you did not anticipate, then add a route for it.
en.type: i drove to the client site last tuesday, what now
en.see: Before the fallback, it answers generatively — confidently, and outside the script.
en.note: Every topic leaks. The question is whether it leaks into something safe.

zh.where: Topics → 你的 topic → 加一个兑底分支
zh.do: 用一个你没预料到的说法提同一件事，然后为它加一条路。
zh.type: i drove to the client site last tuesday, what now
zh.see: 加兑底之前，它会用生成式回答——语气笃定，并且在脚本之外。
zh.note: 每个 topic 都会漏。问题只在于它漏到的地方安不安全。

en.act: Confirm it did not swallow everything else
en.do: Ask an unrelated question that shares a word with your trigger phrases.
en.see: It should answer generatively, not drop into the mileage script.
en.note: Over-broad triggers are the most common defect, and the one nobody tests for.

zh.act: 确认它没把别的都吐吞了
zh.do: 问一个不相干、但和触发词共用某个词的问题。
zh.see: 它应该用生成式回答，而不是掉进里程费那个脚本。
zh.note: 触发词范围过宽是最常见的缺陷，也是最没人去测的。

en.name: Let the model choose the tool
en.teaches: Generative orchestration: describing tools well enough that the agent picks the right one, and seeing what it picked.
en.build: An agent with more than one thing it could do, choosing correctly — and a feel for when it will not.
en.objective: Give an agent several things it could do, have it pick the right one, and see what it picked when it does not.

materials: Two or more tools or knowledge sources with overlapping scope

steps: Enable generative orchestration and describe each tool by when to use it, not by what it is.
Ask something that clearly belongs to one tool and confirm the choice.
Ask something ambiguous and watch which one it reaches for.
Rewrite the losing description until the choice flips.
Write down the cases it still gets wrong — those are your topic candidates.
en.summary: You know how much of the decision to hand to the model, and where to take it back.

zh.name: 让模型自己选工具
zh.teaches: 生成式编排：把工具描述写到 agent 能选对，并且看得见它选了哪个。
zh.build: 一个有多种可能动作的 agent，能选对——以及对「它什么时候会选错」的手感。
zh.objective: 给 agent 多个可选动作，让它选对；选错时你看得见它选了哪个。

materials: 两个以上职责有重叠的工具或知识源

steps: 开启生成式编排，每个工具的描述写「什么时候用它」，而不是「它是什么」。
问一个明显属于某个工具的问题，确认它选对了。
再问一个模棱两可的，看它伸手去拿哪个。
改写没被选中那个的描述，直到选择翻转。
把它依然选错的情况记下来——那些就是该做成 Topic 的候选。
zh.summary: 你清楚了多少判断可以交给模型，以及从哪里开始得收回来。

en.name: Reach a real system
en.teaches: Connectors and custom actions: passing parameters in, getting a result back, and handling the call that fails.
en.build: An agent that reads or writes something outside itself, and does not lie when the call errors.
en.objective: Make an agent read from or write to a system outside itself, and behave correctly when that call fails.

tools: A connector to a system you can actually reach
materials: A test account or credentials for that system

steps: Add a connector and make one read call with a hard-coded parameter.
Replace the hard-coded value with one the agent extracts from the conversation.
Return the result in the agent's own words, not as raw output.
Break it on purpose — wrong id, no permission — and confirm it reports rather than invents.
Note what a user sees when the system is simply down.
en.summary: The agent touches something real, and fails in a way you would be willing to show a user.

zh.name: 连到一个真实系统
zh.teaches: 连接器与自定义动作：把参数传进去、把结果拿回来、以及调用失败时怎么办。
zh.build: 一个能读写外部系统的 agent，并且在调用出错时不会编。
zh.objective: 能让 agent 读写一个外部系统，并在调用失败时表现正确。

tools: 一个你真连得上的系统的连接器
materials: 那个系统的测试账号或凭据

steps: 加一个连接器，先用写死的参数调一次读接口。
把写死的值换成 agent 从对话里提取出来的。
结果用 agent 自己的话说出来，不要直接抛原始输出。
故意弄坏它——错的 id、没权限——确认它如实报告而不是编。
记下系统直接宕机时，用户会看到什么。
zh.summary: agent 碰到了真实系统，而且它出错的样子是你敢给用户看的。

en.name: Put the deterministic steps in a flow
en.teaches: Calling Power Automate from an agent, and drawing the line between what the model decides and what the flow guarantees.
en.build: A flow the agent calls, doing the part that must happen the same way every time.
en.objective: Move the steps that must be identical every time out of the model and into a flow the agent calls.

materials: One process with a step that must not vary

steps: Draw the line: list what the model may decide, and what the flow must guarantee.
Build the flow standalone and test it with fixed inputs first.
Call it from the agent, passing the values the agent gathered.
Handle the flow returning an error, not only a result.
Confirm the deterministic part is identical across five runs.
en.summary: The unreliable part and the guaranteed part are separate, which is what makes the whole thing auditable.

zh.name: 把确定性步骤放进流
zh.teaches: 从 agent 调用 Power Automate，以及划清「模型决定什么」和「流保证什么」的界线。
zh.build: 一条被 agent 调用的流，负责那些每次都必须一模一样的步骤。
zh.objective: 把必须每次一致的步骤从模型里拿出来，放进一条 agent 调用的流。

materials: 一个含有「不允许变」步骤的流程

steps: 先划线：列清楚哪些交给模型判断、哪些必须由流保证。
先把流单独建好，用固定输入测通。
从 agent 调用它，把 agent 收集到的值传进去。
处理流返回错误的情况，而不只是返回结果。
跑五次，确认确定性那部分每次完全一致。
zh.summary: 不可靠的部分和有保证的部分分开了——这正是整件事能被审计的前提。

en.name: Get structured fields out of a document
en.teaches: Reading fields off invoices, forms or contracts, and deciding the confidence line below which a human looks.
en.build: A document in, structured values out, and an exception path for the ones that are not clear enough.
en.objective: Turn a document into structured values, and decide the confidence line below which a person looks at it.

tools: An extraction step such as AI Builder
materials: 20–30 real documents, including the messy ones

steps: Run extraction over a clean document and check every field by hand.
Run it over the worst document you have and note exactly what it got wrong.
Set a confidence threshold and route anything below it to a person.
Write the exception path: what the reviewer sees, and what they do next.
Measure accuracy across the whole sample, not the clean half.
en.summary: You have a number for how often a human is needed — the number the business case depends on.

zh.name: 从文档里抽出结构化字段
zh.teaches: 从发票、表单或合同里读取字段，并定出「低于多少置信度就转人看」的那条线。
zh.build: 文档进、结构化值出，外加一条给「看不清楚的那些」走的异常路径。
zh.objective: 能把文档变成结构化值，并定出「低于多少置信度就转人看」的那条线。

materials: 20–30 份真实单据，包括那些乱七八糟的

steps: 先跑一份干净的单据，逐个字段人工核对。
再跑你手上最差的那份，记清楚它错在哪。
定一个置信度阈值，低于它的全部转人。
把异常路径写出来：审核的人看到什么、接下来干什么。
在全量样本上算准确率，不是只算干净的那一半。
zh.summary: 你拿到了「多大比例需要人介入」这个数——也就是整个投产比的命根子。

en.name: Put a person in the loop
en.teaches: Approval gates: what the agent may do alone, what needs confirming, and what the record of that decision looks like.
en.build: A step that waits for a human, with the approval captured where an auditor could find it.
en.objective: Stop an agent at the point where a person must decide, and leave a record of that decision.

tools: Teams or Outlook for the approval
materials: The list of actions that need a human, and who approves each

steps: Name the actions the agent may take alone, and the ones it may not.
Insert an approval step before the second kind.
Give the approver enough context to decide without opening another system.
Handle rejection and timeout, not only approval.
Confirm the decision, the approver and the timestamp land somewhere findable.
en.summary: There is now a gate a named person owns, and evidence that it was used.

zh.name: 把人放回环里
zh.teaches: 审批闸口：哪些 agent 可以自己做、哪些必须有人确认、以及这个决定留下什么记录。
zh.build: 一个会等人的步骤，且审批记录留在审计的人找得到的地方。
zh.objective: 能在必须由人拍板的地方把 agent 拦下来，并把这个决定留成记录。

tools: 用 Teams 或 Outlook 做审批
materials: 需要人工确认的动作清单，以及各自的审批人

steps: 列明 agent 可以自己做的动作，和不可以的。
在后一类动作前插入审批步骤。
给审批人足够的上下文，让他不用再开另一个系统就能判断。
把驳回和超时也处理了，不能只处理通过。
确认决定、审批人、时间戳都落在了找得到的地方。
zh.summary: 你有了一道由具体的人负责的闸，以及它被用过的证据。

en.name: Give it somewhere to remember
en.teaches: Storing and retrieving structured records in Dataverse, and why a spreadsheet stops working at the second user.
en.build: A table the agent reads and writes, with the permissions that decide who sees which rows.
en.objective: Give the agent structured memory that survives the conversation, with permissions that decide who sees what.

materials: The shape of the record you actually need to keep

steps: Model one table — the fields you will query, not everything you might store.
Write a record from the agent and read it back in a later conversation.
Add a second user and confirm they see only what they should.
Query by something other than the primary key.
Decide what happens to the record when the process it belongs to ends.
en.summary: The agent remembers across sessions, and the permissions on that memory are explicit rather than accidental.

zh.name: 给它一个能记住东西的地方
zh.teaches: 在 Dataverse 里存取结构化记录，以及为什么表格到第二个用户就撑不住了。
zh.build: 一张 agent 读写的表，以及决定「谁能看到哪几行」的权限设置。
zh.objective: 给 agent 一份能跨对话保留的结构化记忆，并把「谁看得到什么」定清楚。

materials: 你真正需要留存的那条记录的结构

steps: 建一张表——只放你会查的字段，不是所有可能存的字段。
从 agent 写一条记录，在下一次对话里把它读回来。
加一个第二个用户，确认他只看得到该看的。
用主键以外的条件查一次。
想清楚：它所属的流程结束后，这条记录怎么办。
zh.summary: agent 能跨会话记住事情了，而且这份记忆的权限是明确设的，不是碰巧的。

en.name: Publish it where people already are
en.teaches: Publishing to Teams or a website, and the sharing and consent questions that appear the moment you do.
en.build: An agent a colleague can open without being told how — the point at which it stops being yours.
en.objective: Put the agent where people already work, and answer the sharing and consent questions that appear the moment you do.

tools: Teams, or a website you can edit
materials: A colleague willing to be the first user

steps: Publish to Teams or a demo site.
Share it with one person and watch them open it without instructions.
Note every consent or permission prompt they hit.
Decide the audience: a team, a department, or everyone.
Publish a change and confirm they get it without doing anything.
en.summary: The agent is somebody else's tool now, which is the first point at which it can create value.

zh.name: 把它发布到人本来就在的地方
zh.teaches: 发布到 Teams 或网站，以及发布那一刻立刻冒出来的共享与授权问题。
zh.build: 一个同事不用教就能打开的 agent——从这一刻起它不再只是你的。
zh.objective: 把 agent 放到人本来就在的地方，并处理好发布那一刻冒出来的共享与授权问题。

tools: Teams，或一个你改得了的网站
materials: 一位愿意当第一个用户的同事

steps: 发布到 Teams 或演示站点。
发给一个人，看他在没人指导的情况下能不能打开。
记下他碰到的每一个授权或权限弹窗。
定下受众范围：一个团队、一个部门，还是所有人。
发布一次修改，确认他什么都不用做就能拿到。
zh.summary: agent 现在是别人的工具了——这是它能产生价值的第一个时刻。

en.name: Keep it inside the guardrails
en.teaches: Environments, DLP policy and roles: where an agent is allowed to live and which connectors it may touch.
en.build: A clear answer to "where does this run, and who decided it could" — before someone from security asks.
en.objective: Be able to say where an agent is allowed to live, which connectors it may touch, and who decided that.

skills: None — this one is a conversation with whoever owns policy
materials: Your environment list and the DLP policy that applies

steps: Find out which environments exist and what each one is for.
Read the DLP policy that applies to the environment you build in.
List the connectors your scenario needs and check each against it.
Agree who approves a new connector, and how long that takes.
Write down where this agent runs, and who signed off.
en.summary: You can answer the security question before it is asked — usually what decides whether the thing ships at all.

zh.name: 让它待在护栏里
zh.teaches: 环境、DLP 策略与角色：agent 允许待在哪、能碰哪些连接器。
zh.build: 对「这东西跑在哪、谁批准的」有个明确答案——赶在安全同事来问之前。
zh.objective: 能说清楚 agent 允许待在哪、能碰哪些连接器、以及这是谁定的。

skills: 无——这一课是和管策略的人聊一次
materials: 你们的环境清单，以及适用的 DLP 策略

steps: 搞清楚现在有哪些环境，各自是干什么的。
读一遍你要建的那个环境适用的 DLP 策略。
列出你的场景需要的连接器，逐个对照策略检查。
谈定：新连接器由谁批、大概要多久。
把「这个 agent 跑在哪、谁签的字」写下来。
zh.summary: 安全的问题你能在被问之前就答上——而这通常就决定了东西能不能上线。

en.name: Find out whether it is working
en.teaches: Session analytics and evaluation: what to measure against the baseline you took before you started.
en.build: A number you would be willing to show at the gate, and the sessions behind it.
en.objective: Tell whether the agent is working, against the baseline you took before it existed.

materials: The before-baseline for the process you changed

steps: Confirm you have a before-number. If you do not, this module is premature.
Pick the two measures that would move if this worked.
Read the session transcripts, not only the counts.
Find the questions it answered badly and classify them.
Report the number and its caveat together, in the same sentence.
en.summary: You have a figure you would defend at a gate, and the transcripts that back it up.

zh.name: 搞清楚它到底有没有用
zh.teaches: 会话分析与评估：对着「开工前记录的基线」该看哪些数。
zh.build: 一个你敢拿到闸门上给人看的数字，以及它背后的会话记录。
zh.objective: 能判断 agent 到底有没有用——对照的是它存在之前你记下的基线。

materials: 你所改变的那个流程的「改之前」基线

steps: 先确认你有「改之前」的数。没有的话，这一课现在上就早了。
选两个「如果真有用就会动」的指标。
读会话原文，不只看计数。
找出它答得差的那些问题，分好类。
报数字的时候，把前提和局限写在同一句话里。
zh.summary: 你有了一个在闸门上站得住的数字，以及支撑它的原始记录。

en.name: Query your operational records
en.teaches: Reading live business records from a spreadsheet, a table or a database, and knowing which of the three a case actually warrants.
en.build: An agent that answers from the records themselves rather than from a document describing them.
en.objective: Query real operational data, and know the point where a spreadsheet stops being defensible and a proper table starts.

tools: A spreadsheet, table or database you are allowed to read
materials: A small extract of real records — orders, stock, tickets, whatever your work turns on

steps: Start on a spreadsheet, but only as a proper table with a unique key — without one, nothing downstream behaves.
Query it with a value the agent extracted from the question rather than one you hard-coded.
Handle the empty result and the hundred-results case before the working path feels finished.
Move the same query onto a table or database view, and note what changed: permissions, speed, and who can see which rows.
Write down the point at which the spreadsheet stops being defensible for this case.
en.summary: The agent answers from records rather than prose, and you can say which store this case belongs in and why.

zh.name: 查询你的业务数据
zh.teaches: 从表格、数据表或数据库里读实时业务记录，并判断某个场景到底该用哪一种。
zh.build: 一个直接依据记录作答的 agent，而不是依据一份描述这些记录的文档。
zh.objective: 会查真实业务数据，并说得清「电子表格到什么时候就不够用了」。

tools: 一份你有权读的表格、数据表或数据库
materials: 一小份真实记录——订单、库存、工单，你的活儿围着什么转就用什么

steps: 先用电子表格，但必须是带唯一键的规范表——没有唯一键，后面全都不对。
查询条件要用 agent 从问题里提取出来的值，不要写死。
先把「查不到」和「查出一百条」这两种情况处理掉，再去看正常路径。
把同一个查询搬到数据表或数据库视图上，记下变化：权限、速度、以及谁能看到哪些行。
写下这个场景里「电子表格不再站得住」的那个临界点。
zh.summary: agent 依据记录作答而不是依据文字描述，而且你说得出这个场景该落在哪种存储上、为什么。

en.name: Extend past the prebuilt connectors
en.teaches: The ladder from custom connector to REST or MCP tool to a second agent, and what each rung costs to own afterwards.
en.build: One capability no prebuilt connector reached, wired in with its contract and its failure behaviour written down.
en.objective: Reach a capability the prebuilt connectors do not cover, using the lowest rung of the ladder that actually gets there.

tools: An API, MCP endpoint or second agent you are allowed to call
materials: The input and output contract of whatever you are calling

steps: Name the thing no prebuilt connector reaches. If one does reach it, stop here and use it.
Take the lowest rung that works: custom connector, then REST or MCP, then a second agent.
Write the input and output contract before wiring anything, including what an error looks like.
Decide whether the model may call this freely, or only a topic may invoke it.
Make the write path idempotent, or make it confirm before it can act twice.
en.summary: You have a capability the platform did not ship with, and a rule for how far up the ladder to climb next time.

zh.name: 越过预建连接器去扩展
zh.teaches: 从自定义连接器，到 REST/MCP 工具，再到第二个 agent 的能力阶梯，以及每一级后续要付的维护代价。
zh.build: 一个预建连接器够不到的能力，接进来，并把契约和失败行为写清楚。
zh.objective: 够到预建连接器覆盖不了的能力，并且用「能够到的最低那一级」去做。

tools: 一个你有权调用的 API、MCP 端点或第二个 agent
materials: 被调用方的输入输出契约

steps: 先说清楚哪件事是预建连接器够不到的。如果其实够得到，就到此为止，直接用。
取能解决问题的最低一级：自定义连接器 → REST/MCP → 第二个 agent。
动手接之前先把输入输出契约写下来，包括「出错长什么样」。
决定这个工具是让模型自由调用，还是只能由某个 topic 显式调用。
写操作要做成幂等的，否则就必须在可能重复执行前先确认。
zh.summary: 你有了一个平台没自带的能力，也有了一条「下次该爬到第几级」的判断标准。

en.name: Test it before you ship it
en.teaches: Building a test set with agreed expected answers, and using it as a gate rather than a formality.
en.build: A re-runnable test set, a pass threshold the business agreed to, and one regression you caught with it.
en.objective: Decide whether the agent is fit to pilot from a test set you can re-run, rather than from a demo that went well.

materials: Questions with agreed correct answers, including ones it should refuse

steps: Write the test set before you tune anything, or you will only write tests it already passes.
Cover five kinds: the normal case, the edge, the out-of-scope, the unauthorised, and a multi-turn exchange.
Agree the pass threshold with whoever owns the process, in writing, before you run it.
Change one thing, re-run the whole set, and look at what else moved.
On a failure, read the activity trace to find which step actually broke rather than guessing at the prompt.
en.summary: Shipping is now a decision against a threshold, instead of a feeling about how the demo went.

zh.name: 上线之前先把它测了
zh.teaches: 建一套有约定标准答案的测试集，并且真的把它当闸门用，而不是走个过场。
zh.build: 一套可重复运行的测试集、一个业务方认可的通过线，以及一个靠它抓出来的回归。
zh.objective: 靠一套能反复跑的测试集来判断能不能试点，而不是靠「刚才那次演示挺顺」。

materials: 带约定标准答案的问题集，包括那些它应该拒绝的

steps: 在调优之前先把测试集写完，否则你写出来的只会是它已经能过的题。
覆盖五类：正常、边界、范围外、越权、以及一次多轮对话。
跑之前，先和流程负责人把通过线白纸黑字定下来。
只改一处，把整套重跑一遍，看看还有什么跟着动了。
失败时去读活动轨迹，找出到底是哪一步断的，而不是对着提示词猜。
zh.summary: 「能不能上」从此是对着一条线做判断，而不是对着一次演示凭感觉。
